a: ls -lah lists all files with human-readable sizes including hidden.
755 means owner rwx, group/others r-x — common for executables/dirs.
chown user:group file changes owner and group.
curl -L -o file url downloads following redirects.
wget url downloads a file; -c resumes a partial download.
grep -RIn pattern . searches recursively, line numbers, ignore case.
df -h shows disk free space in human units.
free -h shows RAM and swap usage.
ps aux lists processes; pipe to grep to find one.
kill PID sends SIGTERM; kill -9 is last resort.
